integrity: Theorem supported by the embedded complete proof. Two reproducible finite programs provide checks for small cases only. No independent certification or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Globally binary circular encoding only; exactly two nonempty blocks; \(n\ge3\); no equivalence under reversal and no result for alphabets larger than two or more partition blocks. Classical de Bruijn count used, not claimed as new. Historical priority requires independent review.
title: Exact enumeration of binary universal cycles for two-block set partitions
